description: Manual check (2026-10-02) of the strongest point-contact candidates from pc_wikipedia.json. A first pass by a helper model was re-checked by hand; verdicts below are the corrected ones. Quotes are verbatim from the cited articles.

evidence.quote: The Federal District shares a small border with [[Minas Gerais]] and is otherwise surrounded by the state of [[Goiás]].
To the north, it shortly borders [[Klina]], to the northeast [[Malisheva]], to the southeast [[Suhareka]] and [[Mamusha]], to the south [[Prizren]], and to the west [[Gjakova]].

evidence.quote: The province borders [[Bitlis Province|Bitlis]] to the north, [[Batman Province|Batman]] to the west, [[Mardin Province|Mardin]] to the southwest, [[Şırnak Province|Şırnak]] to the south, and [[Van Province|Van]] to the east.

Umm Salal shares land borders with [[Ad-Dawhah (municipality)|Doha]] to the southeast, [[Al Rayyan]] to the south, [[Al-Shahaniya]] to the west, [[Al Khor]] to the north, and [[Al Daayen]] to the east.

evidence.quote: Na zahodu meji na občino [[Občina Trbovlje|Trbovlje]], na jugu na [[občina Radeče|Radeče]], na vzhodu na [[Občina Laško|Laško]], ter na severu na [[Občina Žalec|Žalec]].

Občina meji na severu na [[Mestna občina Velenje|mestno občino Velenje]], na vzhodu na občino [[Dobrna]] in Mestno občino [[Celje]], na jugu na občini [[Laško]] in [[Hrastnik]], na zahodu pa na občini [[Prebold]] in [[Polzela]].
The parish has borders with France ([[Occitania]]) and also with the parishes of [[La Massana]], [[Canillo]], and [[Encamp]].

It is bordered by [[Sarpang District|Sarpang]], [[Trongsa District|Trongsa]], [[Bumthang District|Bumthang]], [[Mongar District|Mongar]] and [[Pemagatshel District]]s, and borders [[Assam]] in [[India]] to the south.
